statement: The emotional peak falls in the last third in 16 of 24 analysed books; in 8 the first peak comes at or before the midpoint (plateaus, or bedtime books that peak mid-way and wind down).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025

analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. The wordless journey peaks at page 6 and holds through page 9 before a quiet return: a second plateau shape.
2026-10-15: Counts: support 5 earlier + Ga Mohana, Feathered Friends, Zuko (Book Dash) and Bohlale (African Storybook, first 4 at 0.71). Contradict: Bathtub Safari, Come Back Cat, Khumo (Book Dash, Khumo borderline), Chicken and Millipede (African Storybook, peak 5/5 at 0.45, about 3+ on the engine's 0-3 scale) and Good Night, Monu (StoryWeaver, peak 4/5 at 0.5-0.67, about 2 on 0-3). Two of the counterexamples are bedtime books that peak mid-way and wind down; see c_bedtime_closes_circle. 2026-10-20: +8 works (6 Book Dash, 2 StoryWeaver/Pratham). Goodnight, Tinku! is a plateau from p4 to p8 of 11 that winds down: counted as counterexample. Kottavi Raja peaks again at p16 of 17 after a second, city-wide problem.

magicpaper.suggested: Check where MagicPaper arcs place their most intense page; compare after the corpus grows.
magicpaper.note: Emotion intensity is an analyst judgment per page.
